relations: Low sun near horizon over calm water produces a vertical reflection path that shimmers as surface ripples move.
Small ripples traveling across the sea continuously fragment and reform the glittering sun reflection.
Thin foam along the right shore shifts the waterline around a dark object while the object remains roughly in place.
Cliff, pale building, horizon, sun, and cloud masses hold nearly fixed positions while only water texture changes.
caption: The video captures a calm sea at dusk under a heavy gray sky, the low sun near a flat horizon and throwing a bright vertical column of light across the dark water. A steep cliff topped by a pale building anchors the right, while a pebbly shoreline sweeps diagonally through the foreground. The water moves throughout the scene. Small ripples travel across the surface, so the sun's reflection continuously shimmers, fragments, and reforms in a shifting glittering path. Along the right-hand shore, thin white foam shifts and reshapes the waterline. The sea's overall texture keeps changing without any large surge or splash arriving or ending. The cliff, building, horizon, and sun hold nearly fixed positions, suggesting little or no camera movement. The cloud masses show no clearly resolvable drift, holding their positions overhead. A small dark object near the right waterline stays roughly in place as the foam moves around it.
